title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Commercial lead — brazil em agudos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração em ivoti. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Overview of the role  The Accounting Analyst position serves as the key internal contact for the company's financial information, with full visibility of transactions and responsibility for the source data used in decision-making. title: Estagiário de marketing e redes sociais
description:
Confira a vaga para Estagiário de marketing e redes sociais em toledo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga  Vaga: Estágio em Marketing e Redes Sociais   Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) dinâmico(a) para atuar no setor de Marketing, contribuindo ativamente para a nossa presença digital por meio do relacionamento diário com nossa comunidade nas redes sociais, auxiliando na produção de conteúdos multimídia e dando apoio operacional em nossas rotinas de publicação.  Tipo de vaga:    Trabalho Remoto (Home Office) | Estágio não obrigatório.    Salário:    R$1.067,90   Regime    Home office    Jornada:   30h semanais    Benefícios:   Auxílio-alimentação de R$364,06;  Auxílio-saúde de R$98,65;  Auxílio home-office de R$123,78;  Vale-inglês: curso de inglês completo + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA, disponível para o colaborador e um dependente;  Vale-alemão: curso de alemão + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA, disponível para o colaborador e um dependente;  Clude Saúde: consultas médicas + nutricionista + desconto em farmácias;  C4 Life: terapia online, diagnóstico e análise de comportamento, coaching, consultorias jurídicas, e mais;  Totalpass: 20 mil academias e estúdios, totalplay, totalclub, queima diária, terapia, nutrição;  Grupo de motivação fitness;  Bradesco Odonto: opção por contribuição, aberto a dependentes, com urgência, 2 limpezas por ano e exames + clube de vantagens.  Treinamentos em vendas, marketing e gestão;  Kit de boas vindas;  #EUVISTOACAMISA: novas camisetas da escola a cada novo ano de empresa;  Day-off no aniversário + presente surpresa;  Convênio com o SESC: clubes, hospedagem, cursos, eventos e serviços para família;  Bônus Indique e Ganhe.    Principais atividades:   As principais atribuições do(a) estagiário(a) se darão no auxílio às tarefas de:  Gestão de Comunidades:  Auxiliar no monitoramento e na interação ativa com o público, respondendo a comentários, mensagens diretas (DMs) e dúvidas em todas as nossas plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, Linked In, Tik Tok, You Tube e Blog);   Produção de Conteúdo:  Auxiliar na criação de materiais visuais atrativos para as redes sociais (carrosséis, posts estáticos e stories) e na redação de descrições (copies) engajadoras;   Gestão de Publicações:  Dar apoio ao agendamento e à postagem de conteúdos em múltiplos canais, incluindo redes sociais, Word Press (artigos), You Tube (upload de aulas) e grupos de transmissão (Whats App, Telegram e Discord);  Suporte Estratégico e Administrativo:  Participar de reuniões de alinhamento, apoiar operacionalmente a equipe e auxiliar na atualização de planilhas de controle.    Perfil:   Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;  Boa organização e gestão de tempo;  Autonomia e disciplina para atuar e render bem em um ambiente 100% remoto (Home Office);  Perfil proativo e curioso com vontade real de aprender, se desenvolver profissionalmente e trazer novas ideias para a equipe.    Requisitos  :  Familiaridade como usuário e criador nas principais plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, Linked In, You Tube, Tik Tok e Telegram);  Dispor de um ambiente tranquilo para trabalhar, com internet estável, smartphone e um computador com bom processamento, equipado com webcam, mouse e teclado;  Vídeo de apresentação  devidamente enviado (instruções abaixo).    Diferenciais (não obrigatório) :   Conhecimento prático em  Canva  para o auxílio na produção de peças visuais rápidas (stories, carrosséis, etc.);   Familiaridade com o uso de IAs generativas ( Chat GPT, Gemini  , etc.) para auxiliar em pesquisas, ideias e otimização de rotinas;   Experiência básica com  Notion  para acompanhamento de tarefas;   Conhecimento básico em  Word Press  (focado na postagem e formatação de artigos);   Domínio do idioma  inglês  e/ou  alemão  .    Preferencialmente, deve estar cursando  :  Marketing;  Jornalismo;  Relações Internacionais;  Administração de Empresas;  Publicidade e Propaganda;  Relações Públicas;  Comunicação Social;  Gestão Comercial;  Comércio Exterior;  Design Gráfico.    Sobre a empresa:    A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma edtech brasileira, fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. No inglês, destaca-se com metodologia inovadora de aprendizagem acelerada e índice de 98,9% de satisfação. A empresa irá capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês, possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e tem valor de mercado superior a 30 milhões de reais.    Etapas do processo:   Seleção de currículos + vídeo de até 1 minuto (instruções abaixo);  Entrevista 1;  Entrevista 2;  Aprovação.    Inicio: maio/2026  Instruções para o Vídeo de Apresentação e Envio   Como a comunicação é fundamental para essa vaga, queremos te conhecer além do currículo! Grave um vídeo rápido seguindo as orientações abaixo:  Duração:   No máximo 60 segundos.  Apresentação Pessoal:   Conte rapidamente quem é você (nome, idade, cidade/estado onde mora e o que estuda).  O seu match com a vaga:   Explique como as suas habilidades, experiências ou o seu perfil podem contribuir para os resultados do nosso setor de parcerias comerciais.  Expectativa de aprendizado:   Diga rapidamente o que você espera aprender e desenvolver no dia a dia desse estágio.  Dica: Não se preocupe com edições complexas ou superprodução. Seja autêntico(a), demonstre sua energia e certifique-se apenas de que o áudio esteja claro e o ambiente bem iluminado.  Prazo para envio: 05/05/2026.   Como se candidatar:   Envie o seu currículo atualizado junto com o vídeo para o Whatsapp ou e-mail:   Email:   Whatsapp:    Assunto do e-mail obrigatório: Vaga Estágio Marketing - (Seu Nome e Sobrenome)  Atenção!!! Caso prefira anexar o link do vídeo no Google Drive, Lembre-se de configurar o link ABERTO, para podermos acessar!!

title: Sr. compliance onboarding specialist
description:
Confira a vaga para Sr. compliance onboarding specialist em criciúma. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role  We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.  You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.  Key Responsibilities   Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.  Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.  Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.  Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.  Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.  Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.    What We’re Looking For   Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.  3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.  Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks  Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations  Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC  Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.  Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.  Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).  Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Commercial lead — brazil em jaraguá do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração em araraquara. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Platform engineer / devops engineer em colombo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title:   Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer   Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:  12+ months with extensions  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours:  EST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview   We’re hiring a hands-on  Platform / Dev Ops Engineer  to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role  —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers  to ship code efficiently and reliably.  You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in  day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement  .  What You’ll Do   Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage  Kubernetes environments  : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting   Support and enhance  CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)  Maintain and improve  self-service workflows  , templates, and developer “golden paths”  Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry  ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality   Assist with  service instrumentation  across logging, metrics, and tracing   Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs  Participate in  on-call rotation  and support incident response   Optimize infrastructure for  cost, performance, and reliability    Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)   Must-Have Requirements   6+ years  in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles   Strong  AWS experience  (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)  Deep  Kubernetes expertise  :   Operating and maintaining clusters  Experience building Kubernetes environments  Hands-on  Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)   Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling   Experience owning and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines    Strong  Linux fundamentals    Solid understanding of  observability concepts  (metrics, logs, tracing)   Preferred Qualifications    Experience with  Git Lab CI    Exposure to  Open Telemetry    API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting  large engineering teams (100+ developers)   Familiarity with  security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows    Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in  mid-size, modern engineering organizations     What We’re NOT Looking For   No Kubernetes experience ❌ Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌ Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌ Pure security-focused candidates ❌ Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌ ML/Data Science profiles ❌   Team Structure   1 Principal Engineer  1 Senior Engineer  1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Executivo de contas
description:
Empresa está contratando Executivo de contas em viamão. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Estamos contratando: Account Executive | SIGGA Technologies  Você já atuou com manutenção industrial, gestão de ativos ou soluções SAP (especialmente SAP PM)? Então essa oportunidade pode ser para você.  Na SIGGA, buscamos um(a) Account Executive com forte perfil consultivo, capaz de conectar tecnologia ao negócio e gerar valor real para nossos clientes. Mais do que vender, queremos alguém que entenda a dor do cliente — especialmente em ambientes industriais — e saiba traduzir isso em soluções estratégicas.  Quem somos? Com presença na América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia, a SIGGA está inserida nas rotinas industriais das maiores empresas do mundo. OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. Merit and promotion annual cycle.    And muuuuuuch more!

title: Graphic designer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Graphic designer em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Graphic Designer  Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.  You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.  What you’ll do   You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns  Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web  Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow  Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns  Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG) Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations  Edit video for social distribution and website use  Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative  This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.    What matters in this role   You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction  You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio  You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time  You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement  You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks    Requirements   4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams  Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals  Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts) Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video) Video editing experience for social and web content  Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite    Context for the work   Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:  Driving registrations and product demos  Increasing engagement  Supporting sales follow-up  Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders    The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.  What this is not   Not a pure brand exploration role  Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment  Not isolated design work handed over a wall    You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.  If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

description:

Job Title:  AI Engineer  Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.” Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  .   Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Estamos contratando: Account Executive | SIGGA Technologies  Você já atuou com manutenção industrial, gestão de ativos ou soluções SAP (especialmente SAP PM)? Então essa oportunidade pode ser para você.  Na SIGGA, buscamos um(a) Account Executive com forte perfil consultivo, capaz de conectar tecnologia ao negócio e gerar valor real para nossos clientes. Mais do que vender, queremos alguém que entenda a dor do cliente — especialmente em ambientes industriais — e saiba traduzir isso em soluções estratégicas.  Quem somos? Com presença na América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia, a SIGGA está inserida nas rotinas industriais das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos movidos por inovação e pela Indústria 4.0, ajudando nossos clientes a aumentarem eficiência, produtividade e confiabilidade na gestão de ativos com SAP.  Por que essa experiência é importante? Nosso diferencial está em entender profundamente o contexto operacional dos nossos clientes. Ter vivência com manutenção, EAM ou SAP PM permite uma atuação muito mais estratégica, com conversas de alto nível e foco em geração de valor.  O que você vai fazer:  Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas (end-to-end) Desenvolver e qualificar oportunidades  Apresentar soluções e propostas comerciais  Atuar de forma consultiva com grandes contas  Trabalhar em parceria com pré-vendas e times internos  Gerenciar pipeline e oportunidades via CRM  O que buscamos:  Experiência como Account Executive em ambiente B2 B  Vivência com vendas consultivas de software (modelo Saa S / ARR) Experiência com grandes contas  Conhecimento em CRM  Diferencial importante: experiência com SAP, manutenção, gestão de ativos ou soluções como IBM Maximo, Oracle EAM  Benefícios:  Vale Refeição/Alimentação  Plano de Saúde e Odontológico  Seguro de Vida  Gympass  Sistema de bonificação  Apoio Pass  Sem dress code  Faça parte da transformação digital da indústria com a gente!

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em santana de parnaíba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic). Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

About Foundey Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting Saa S, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits. The Opportunity We're looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey's pipeline of high-quality startup clients. Key Responsibilities Identify and research potential clients within Saa S, AI, and tech startup ecosystems Conduct outbound prospecting via email, Linked In, and other channels Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging Track activities and performance using CRM tools Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback Qualifications 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in Saa S or agency environments) Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce) Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)Nice to Have Experience selling design, product, or digital services Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development Experience working with early-stage startups or founders Why Join Us? At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Graphic designer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Graphic designer em são josé dos pinhais. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Graphic Designer  Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.  You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.  What you’ll do   You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns  Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web  Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow  Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns  Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG) Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations  Edit video for social distribution and website use  Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative  This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.    What matters in this role   You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction  You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio  You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time  You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement  You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks    Requirements   4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams  Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals  Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts) Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video) Video editing experience for social and web content  Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite    Context for the work   Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:  Driving registrations and product demos  Increasing engagement  Supporting sales follow-up  Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders    The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.  What this is not   Not a pure brand exploration role  Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment  Not isolated design work handed over a wall    You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.  If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Nova oportunidade para Investment banking intern em eldorado do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are  hungry, quick learners, and committed  to excelling in a fast-paced environment.  How to Apply:   Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.  This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:

Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos. Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM. Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos. A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família. Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal. Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher. A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil. Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos. Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena. title: Supervisor de importação e exportação
description:

A Brink’s  é uma empresa líder global em gestão de numerário e valores, soluções digitais para o varejo e serviços gerenciados de ATM.  Nossos clientes incluem instituições financeiras, varejistas, órgãos governamentais, casas da moeda, joalherias e outras operações comerciais. Nossa rede de operações em 51 países atende clientes em mais de 100 países.  Acreditamos na construção de parcerias que protegem o comércio, e isso exige fomentar uma cultura engajada que valorize pessoas com diferentes origens, ideias e perspectivas.  Construímos um senso de pertencimento, para que todos os colaboradores se sintam respeitados, seguros e valorizados, e oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para participação e crescimento.  Como pessoa Supervisora de Importação e Exportação você será responsável por liderar e garantir toda a documentação necessária para os embarques nos processos de importação e exportação, cumprindo prazos e especificações dos órgãos legais e conforme determinação contratual.  Responsabilidades    Supervisionar diariamente no sistema da Receita Federal a existência de novos pedidos de embarque, acionando as áreas envolvidas e tomando as medidas necessárias;  Supervisionar o time quanto à documentação emitida a fim de evitar embarques incorretos;  Manter contato permanente com clientes externos e internos (nacional e internacional), avaliando a necessidade de correções de documentos e providenciando-os, a fim de manter os padrões exigidos pela legislação evitando penalidades e multas perante as alfândegas brasileira e do exterior;  Manter contato com o departamento de controle das filiais a fim de acompanhar as coletas (exportação) e entregas (importação) e posicionar Brink's e clientes quanto aos embarques cuja contratação é "porta a porta";  Supervisionar atividades administrativas como conferências e pagamento de frete aéreo internacional e valores a serem faturados;  Conhecer e interpretar os Inconterms (negociações entre importador e exportador) e providenciar instruções de emissão de documentos de acordo com o Incoterm negociado;  Seguir procedimentos internos de segurança e sigilo da informação;  Manter o cliente devidamente informado de todos os passos/acontecimentos do processo;  Participar dos programas de melhoria contínua e disseminar novas propostas de processos junto ao time.    Desafios    Garantir que os processos de importação e exportação ocorram de maneira correta e eficaz, providenciando todos os documentos necessários para embarque para exportação e conferência na importação, cumprindo os prazos estabelecidos e evitando penalidades e sanções.

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Cloud operations engineer em itatiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Eightpoint Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love. About the Role The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams. Key Responsibilities Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure. Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling. Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners. Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation. Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime). Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform. Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones. Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures. Who You Are5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role. Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front). Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions. Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA. Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting). Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence). Preferred Qualifications Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services. Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro). Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms. AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer). Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging. Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: English teacher
description:
Confira a vaga para English teacher em são josé. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!You be your own boss and set your own scheduleWork from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.C1 or C2 Level English SpeakerUniversity degree in English Teaching or related area.One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.Must pass a criminal background check.Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

description:
