description:
Empresa está contratando Csc jaguariúna – especialista de dados jr| legal intelligence em jaguariúna. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

JOB DESCRIPTION    Área de Atuação:  A vaga está inserida na área de Legal Intelligence  , dentro do Jurídico da Ambev. Essa área atua como o braço de dados, tecnologia e inovação do Jurídico  , conectando informações jurídicas, automação e análises avançadas para apoiar decisões estratégicas, aumentar eficiência operacional e gerar impacto real para o negócio.  Contexto atual da área e cargo  : O Jurídico da Ambev passa por um momento de forte transformação digital  , com foco em automação de processos, uso estratégico de dados e aplicação de tecnologias de IA. A prioridade da área é estruturar bases de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e integradas  , viabilizando iniciativas como jurimetria, dashboards executivos, automações e soluções de inteligência artificial. Esse cargo nasce para sustentar e acelerar essa agenda, com visão de médio e longo prazo.  Papel/Missão do Cargo:   O/a Especialista de Dados será responsável por desenhar, construir e evoluir soluções de dados escaláveis para o Jurídico  , atuando desde a modelagem e engenharia até a automação e integração entre sistemas. Sua missão é transformar dados complexos em ativos estratégicos  , garantindo qualidade, eficiência e impacto direto nas decisões e nos resultados da área  Principais Desafios:   Estruturar e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis  em um ambiente com múltiplas fontes.  Traduzir necessidades do Jurídico  em soluções técnicas eficientes.  Equilibrar qualidade dos dados, velocidade de entrega e escalabilidade  .  Atuar como referência técnica  , apoiando o time e disseminando boas práticas.  Evoluir soluções existentes enquanto constrói novas frentes de dados e automação.  Pontos Diferenciais da vaga:   Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alto impacto  para o Jurídico e para a companhia.  Uso intensivo de tecnologias modernas  (Databricks, Py Spark, BI, APIs, automação).  Ambiente com alto nível técnico  , autonomia e espaço para propor soluções.  Forte conexão com inovação, dados e inteligência artificial  .  Visibilidade, aprendizado contínuo e oportunidade de crescimento técnico e de impacto.  Cultura:  Na Ambev, valorizamos pessoas protagonistas, que sonham grande e buscam melhorar sempre, com escuta ativa, colaboração e simplicidade para transformar desafios em oportunidades. Venha crescer com a gente e fazer parte de um time que aprende junto, entrega impacto real e celebra cada conquista.  RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS    Responsabilidades e Atribuições:   Desenvolver, automatizar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis  para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de informações jurídicas.  Realizar modelagem de dados analítica  , garantindo qualidade, consistência e estrutura adequada para BI, dashboards e análises estratégicas.  Implementar e evoluir transformações de dados em Databricks (Py Spark)  , com foco em performance e sustentabilidade.  Construir e manter integrações entre sistemas  por meio de APIs, scripts e processos ETL/ELT.  Apoiar iniciativas de automação de processos  , reduzindo atividades manuais e retrabalho no Jurídico.  Atuar como referência técnica em dados  , orientando o time em boas práticas de engenharia, modelagem e governança.  Trabalhar em parceria com áreas jurídicas e de negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas eficazes  .  Contribuir para a evolução contínua da arquitetura de dados  , preparando a base para iniciativas de BI, jurimetria e inteligência artificial.  REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS    Requisitos Obrigatórios     Ensino Superior completo.  Experiência sólida com engenharia e modelagem de dados  , atuando na construção e manutenção de pipelines.  Domínio de SQL  para consultas, transformação e análise de dados.  Experiência prática com Python  , aplicada a processamento e automação de dados.  Vivência com ambientes de dados escaláveis  , como Data Lakes ou plataformas de processamento distribuído.  Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma  , com visão de solução e foco em entrega.  Boa comunicação para interagir com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.  Experiências Desejadas     Experiência com Databricks e Py Spark  .  Vivência com arquiteturas Lakehouse  .  Experiência com ferramentas de BI  (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).  Conhecimento em integrações via APIs  , ETL/ELT e automação de processos.  Experiência com orquestração ou automação  (Airflow, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares).  Vivência prévia em Legal Ops, Legal Intelligence, Jurídico  ou áreas com dados complexos e regulatórios.  Experiência atuando como referência técnica  ou apoiando tecnicamente outros profissionais.  ADDITIONAL INFORMATION    Na Ambev, oferecemos um pacote completo de benefícios pensado para você e também para seus dependentes. Confira o que você encontra por aqui:  Saúde e Bem-estar   Plano Médico e Telemedicina 24h  Plano Odontológico  Convênio Farmácia  Gympass (wellhub)  Seguro de Vida   Alimentação e Transporte   Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação;  Vale Transporte  Fretado (para a região do CSC em Jaguariúna)   Descontos e Vantagens   Venda mensal de produtos Ambev com preço especial  Descontos em canais da companhia (ex: Chopp Brahma Express)  Ben Up: plataforma de benefícios e descontos  Financeiro e Reconhecimento   Participação nos Lucros (PLR)  Abono Assiduidade (14º salário)  Previdência Privada com contribuição da Ambev (IAPP)  Empréstimo Consignado   E muito mais! Somos milhares de apaixonados e apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. Temos um orgulho imenso do nosso poder de impacto positivo e reconhecemos que, agindo como donos e donas, cada um de nós desempenha um papel fundamental no sucesso do nosso ecossistema. Somado a isso, todas nossas grandes conquistas tem o sabor da colaboração! Nosso sucesso é compartilhado e acreditamos que por meio da colaboração podemos encantar ainda mais o nossos clientes com as marcas que eles amam hoje, ao mesmo tempo em que podemos atender aos gostos de amanhã.   A Nossa Cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde as pessoas possam ser o melhor delas mesmas - e nos ajudar a ser a nossa melhor versão! Procuramos gente com paixão, curiosidade e coragem para fazer a diferença aqui.   Acolhemos talentos diversos, porque acreditamos que grandes ideias vêm de pessoas com diferentes trajetórias. Oferecemos oportunidades para talentos que estão ingressando no mercado de trabalho e somos apaixonados por impulsionar a nossa gente.  É trabalhando e crescendo juntos que atingimos o nosso propósito: Sonhamos Grande por um Futuro com Mais Razões para Brindar!

JOB DESCRIPTION    VIVER DESIGN ESTÁ NO NOSSO DNA   Pra nós, transformar ambientes e emocionar pessoas faz parte do nosso propósito de vida, guiando nossas iniciativas em prol de um futuro cada vez mais humano e sustentável. Venha fazer parte desse TIME!    #Seja Portobello #Portobello Lover   RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS    Sua missão em nosso time será:  Gestão de Estratégia de Preços:  Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de precificação alinhadas aos objetivos de posicionamento da marca e metas financeiras.  Análise de Elasticidade e Demanda:  Monitorar como as variações de preço afetam o volume de vendas e sugerir ajustes para otimizar a receita total.  Monitoramento de Mercado:  Realizar o acompanhamento constante dos movimentos da concorrência, identificando tendências e ameaças competitivas.  Modelagem de Dados:  Construir dashboards e modelos estatísticos para automatizar decisões de preço e prever cenários futuros.  Interface Multidisciplinar:  Colaborar com os times de Vendas, Marketing e Finanças para alinhar o custo com a expectativa de venda.  Análise de Mix e Valor Agregado:  Diferenciar a estratégia de preço entre produtos de alto volume e produtos de alto valor agregado.  Análise de Market Share vs. Rentabilidade:  Avaliar o posicionamento frente aos principais players do setor cerâmico nacional e internacional.  Adequação de Tabelas de Preço:  Liderar a transição das tabelas de preços "com impostos por dentro" para o novo modelo de "impostos por fora", garantindo que a margem líquida da companhia seja preservada.  Reforma Tributária:  Atuar como ponto focal para as áreas de Vendas, Compras, TI e Logística, explicando como a mudança na tributação afetará a margem de contribuição e a competitividade.  REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS    O que é necessário para se inscrever:  Escolaridade: Superior (Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas);  Conhecimento técnicos: Pacote Office Avançado;  Experiência prévia em análise de dados, precificação e sistema tributário;  Experiência em gestão de projetos em precificação;  ADDITIONAL INFORMATION    Nos preocupamos com o bem-estar dos nossos Portobellolovers e oferecemos benefícios como:  Seguro de vida;  Plano de saúde e odontológico;  Restaurante na empresa;  Vale transporte ou ônibus fretado exclusivo para colaboradores - rotas específicas;  Plataforma Corporativa Universidade Portobello;  Ambulatório Interno;  Ginástica laboral;  Participação nos Lucros e Resultados PPR;  Descontos em farmácias da região;  Estacionamento gratuito;  Previdência Privada;  Sindicato;  Rede de descontos - parcerias com diversas instituições de Ensino;  Descontos nas compras de produtos Portobello;  Abono Férias;  Auxílio Mamãe Portobello - para compra do enxoval do bebê;  Auxílio creche;  Assistência a dependentes PCDs;  Programas de Capacitação e Desenvolvimento Profissional;  Wellhub e muitos mais!!!  Horário:  8h00 às 17h00 (Segunda a Sexta)  Modelo de trabalho:  Presencial  Local de Trabalho:  Fábrica da Portobello – Tijucas / SC.  Viver Design está no nosso DNA    Transformar ambientes e emocionar pessoas faz parte do propósito do Portobello Grupo, guiando nossas contribuições para a construção de um presente e futuro mais humanos e sustentáveis.   Somos uma empresa GLOBAL, com mais de 46 anos de atuação  , e nossa marca é líder no mercado brasileiro no segmento de revestimentos cerâmicos, além de uma referência em Sustentabilidade, Inovação, Arquitetura e Design.  Nossa histórica começou em Tijucas (SC), mas atualmente o Grupo é formado por quatro unidades de negócio: unidade Portobello, Portobello Shop, Pointer e Portobello America  . Conheça algumas curiosidades sobre o Portobello Grupo:   Somos uma empresa listada na B3  (PTBL3), que exporta para mais de 70 países  e compactuamos com os Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (ODS) da ONU  ;  Em 2014 criamos a Pointer, nossa marca de design democrático  , cuja fábrica está localizada em Marechal Deodoro (AL);  Inauguramos nossa primeira fábrica fora do Brasil  em outubro de 2023. A Portobello America está localizada em Baxter, no estado do Tennessee;  Com a Portobello Shop, contamos com 163 lojas  (próprias e franquias) e estamos em cerca de 600 PDVs  por todo o país, por meio de grandes parceiros do mercado, como Cassol Centerlar, Balaroti e Leroy Merlin;  Por sete anos consecutivos, fomos campeões do Prêmio Reclame Aqui  , atestando a reputação da nossa marca e o interesse em oferecer as melhores experiências para nossos clientes;  Os Portobello Lovers são os grandes protagonistas quando o assunto é impacto social  . Contamos com iniciativas, como o Programa de Voluntariado, Embaixadores do Meio Ambiente e Embaixadores da Diversidade.  Cuidamos e valorizamos a nossa gente, acreditando em seus potenciais de evoluir e transformar o mundo para melhor. Venha fazer parte deste time!   ATENÇÃO:  as vagas divulgadas nesta página são da área Corporativa do Grupo e da unidade Portobello  . Caso você tenha interesse em conhecer as oportunidades da nossa unidade de varejo, a Portobello Shop, acesse essa página de Carreiras.  #Seja Portobello #Portobello Lover #Portobello Grupo

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical recruiter (remote) em curitiba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Reboot Monkey   Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents  . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide.  We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  About the Role   Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.  As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania  , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician  . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try.  This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT  or managed DCTs directly  . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management.  What You'll Do   Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region   Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords   Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score   Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history   Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria   Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training   Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team   Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region   Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them   Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings    Requirements   3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)   Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills   Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring   Fluent written and spoken English   Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision   Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION    A NAVA está em busca de  uma    PESSOA ANALISTA DE SEGURANÇA DA INFORMAÇÃO SR - FORENSE/INCIDENTES  para fazer parte do nosso time de pessoas incríveis!    Por que trabalhar na NAVA?   Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que atende as maiores companhias dos setores financeiro, seguros, meios de pagamento, telecomunicações, energia e varejo do país. Inspiramos nossos times a criar soluções para que essas companhias transformem e impactem positivamente o mundo.   Temos um time curioso, criativo, energético e inspirador, com grande foco nas pessoas para gerar inovação, transformação e crescimento. Dentro de um ambiente dinâmico e ágil, o nosso time está em expansão para acompanhar o crescimento exponencial da NAVA e dos nossos Clientes.    RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS     Como será o seu dia a dia?    Cooperar estreitamente com o líder técnico para garantir que a criação de playbooks atenda aos requisitos do cliente e esteja alinhada com as melhores práticas;  Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar as melhores praticas de segurança, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas e aplicativos;  Monitorar e analisar violações de segurança, coordenando atividades de resposta a incidentes;  Manter-se atualizado sobre ameaças, vulnerabilidades e tendencias emergentes do setor financeiro;  Atuar em salas de crise com direcionamento e entendimento técnicos para resolução de problemas;  Apoiar na criação de indicadores e monitoração aos riscos e controles.  Responsável por manter as caixas de Abuse da Organização;  Realizar as notificações e takedown de phishing, smishing, entre outros vetores de ataque;  Direcionar internamente incidentes para tratamento das áreas correspondentes;  Atuação em incidentes com visão técnica de como direcionar e tratar o cenário para o mínimo impacto possível.    REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS      O que esperamos de você?    Formação Superior em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatadas;  Conhecimento em testes focados em Prevenção à Fraude (Phishing, Vishing, Engenharia Social, etc);  Conhecimento básico em uma ou mais linguagens de programação;  Conhecimento em ambientes Cloud.  Certificação Information Security Foundation;  Conhecimento solido nos princípios básicos de Segurança da Informação como: Confidencialidade, Integridade, Disponibilidade e Autenticidade;  Experiencia em monitoramento através de ferramenta de SIEM / SOAR;  Conhecimento de sysadmin em Linux, Windows;  Conhecimento em Analise de Cabeçalho de E-mail;  Conhecimento em leitura de Logs;  Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação como Python, Java, Javascript, PHP, ASP, etc.  Inglês intermediário/avançado    DIFERENCIAL    Certificação Information Security Foundation (ISFS)  ITIL    ADDITIONAL INFORMATION     Horário de trabalho: Comercial    Modelo de trabalho para este cliente/projeto: Híbrido    Local de trabalho: Osasco/SP    Além de ser uma empresa certificada Great Place to Work, você vai encontrar na NAVA:   Oportunidades de carreira  Liberdade para escrever seu próprio código  Diversidade e diferentes formas de ver o mundo  Comunidades que incentivam o crescimento de todos  Treinamento In Company  Um time incrível  Empresa engajada no Pacto Global da ONU  Projetos inovadores  Alta avaliação no Glassdoor   Sobre a NAVA    Somos uma empresa de tecnologia apaixonada por pessoas e inovação.  Inspiramos nossos times a criar soluções para que as maiores e melhores companhias do país transformem e impactem positivamente o mundo. Estamos de portas e braços abertos para todas as pessoas que desejam ser protagonistas de suas vidas e se tornarem tão grandes quanto seus sonhos, independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, religião, faixa etária ou deficiência. title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em gravataí. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Analista comercial - inside sales
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista comercial - inside sales em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Local: Greystar Primeiramente, nós apresentamos: Somos a Greystar, um conceito de apartamentos de aluguel totalmente equipados, com um serviço de gerenciamento profissional que está estabelecendo o padrão no mercado. Desde a nossa fundação, buscamos oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo, focado em proporcionar aos nossos residentes uma experiência única. Nosso principal objetivo? É oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo focado em nossos residentes vivendo uma experiência única. Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base em nossos pilares e valores; nossos pilares servem de guia para "o que fazemos" e nossos valores orientam "a forma como fazemos". Acreditamos firmemente que a diversidade agrega valor. É por isso que nossos valores promovem um ambiente de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão, estabelecendo uma base e uma mentalidade pela qual orientamos os membros da equipe, nossos residentes, comunidades e parceiros. Somos uma empresa comprometida em criar um ótimo local de trabalho para todos e reforçamos isso com nossas iniciativas de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão. Chamou sua atenção? Quer saber mais sobre as funções? Perfil procurado: Momento de carreira: Profissional com experiência prática em vendas e atendimento. Alguém em fase de crescimento na carreira, com energia e ambição para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico. Formação e experiências anteriores: Preferencialmente com passagem por startups, ou empresas de tecnologia ligadas ao setor imobiliário principalmente de curta estadia, para entender mais do nosso dinamismo. Experiência com inside sales, atendimento digital e foco em fechamento são diferenciais. Habilidades técnicas: Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de CRM, domínio do pacote Office (com foco em Excel) e boa fluência em Outlook. É essencial ter excelente escrita – clara, profissional e persuasiva, tanto para e-mails quanto para Whats App, além de boa comunicação presencial. Comunicação e perfil comercial: Boa escuta, empatia e firmeza para negociar. Buscamos alguém com perfil closer, com habilidade para contornar objeções, ler o momento do lead e conduzi-lo até o fechamento. Comportamento e atitude: Perfil colaborativo, alto astral, despojado, com senso de dono e foco em metas. Flexível e adaptável a mudanças de processo, com facilidade em lidar com tecnologia. Valoriza o trabalho em equipe, mas tem autonomia para tocar suas entregas com responsabilidade. Idioma: Inglês intermediário, sendo capaz de conversar com clientes estrangeiros e explicar de forma clara o processo de locação.  Funções: Gestão Comercial: Gerir o ciclo completo de vida do cliente, desde a prospecção, acompanhamento e fechamento, visando a máxima ocupação das unidades (seguindo os padrões de qualidade da empresa). Visitas Comerciais: Realizar visitas comerciais aos imóveis, mostrando os apartamentos, explicando o conceito e também as áreas comuns. Gestão de Clientes: Contribuir proativamente para a construção e desenvolvimento da melhor experiência para os nossos clientes, organizando eventos, remoções e atividades diversas. Gestão de Indicadores: Monitorar diariamente os principais indicadores de gestão através do CRM.  Benefícios: Vale Transporte Cartão Alimentação Flash (flexível) Comissão variável de acordo com a política vigente Remuneração fixa mensal Plano de Saúde – 100% subsidiado para titulares e dependentes Plano Odontológico – 100% subsidiado para titulares e dependentes Seguro de vida em grupo Total Pass Open English Day-Off

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em santo andré. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em blumenau. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Platform engineer / devops engineer em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em são josé. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Platform engineer / devops engineer em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em canoas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em ivoti. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Platform engineer / devops engineer em mogi das cruzes. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em jundiaí. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member
