title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em caxias do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Platform engineer / devops engineer em gravataí. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

description:
Empresa está contratando Analista comercial pl. em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Junte-se à equipe do Grupo CRM e faça parte de uma cultura que valoriza as pessoas como o principal ingrediente do nosso sucesso. Buscamos Analista Comercial Pl. Se você é proativo, tem orgulho do que faz e está pronto para enfrentar desafios em um ambiente estimulante de crescimento pessoal e profissional, venha fazer parte dessa jornada única. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial, e/ou áreas correlatas; Conhecimento avançado em Excel (consolidação de dados, segmentação de dados, dashboards); Conhecimento intermediário em Power Point (habilidade para realizar PPT executivo); Experiência em varejo, indicadores e performance de vendas do varejo. Informações adicionais Além do salário, você terá como benefícios: Vale Transporte; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Assistência Médica; Seguro de Vida; Convênio Farmácia; Descontos nos Produtos. Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e aproveite todos esses benefícios!

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em florianópolis. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em eldorado do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Gerente geral de propriedade
description:
Nova oportunidade para Gerente geral de propriedade em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Você quer enfrentar novos desafios em uma indústria dinâmica? Você tem experiência liderando projetos onde teve que fortalecer as áreas de operações, comercial e atendimento ao cliente? Então, essa vaga é para você! Primeiro, nos apresentamos: Somos a Greystar, uma empresa com um modelo de negócio focado na gestão, desenvolvimento e investimento de apartamentos para aluguer totalmente equipados, com espaços comuns acolhedores e um serviço de administração profissional que é referência no mercado. Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base nos nossos pilares e valores; Nossos pilares nos orientam para "o que fazemos" e nossos valores norteiam "como fazemos". Hoje estamos em processo de crescimento no mercado brasileiro e por isso procuramos pessoas apaixonadas, dispostas a contribuir no que for necessário para alcançarmos juntos o melhor progresso. Você pode ser nosso próximo " Gerente de Propriedades" O que é ou faz um Gerente Geral de Propriedades? O Gerente Geral de Propriedade é uma função importante para nossas operações. É ele quem lidera toda a operação dentro do local ou prédio. Apoia, desenvolve e executa estratégias da empresa relacionadas à operação/gestão de um imóvel, orientando os integrantes da equipe, implementando e melhorando continuamente para que o imóvel atenda e supere as metas financeiras orçadas. Isto, a fim de alcançar um ótimo desempenho comercial e operacional. Estas podem ser suas funções: Liderar as equipes de atendimento ao cliente e manutenção. Preparação de relatórios financeiros para nossos investidores. Gestão de equipes, levando a promover a criação do melhor local para trabalhar. Elaboração e gestão de orçamentos. Gestão proativa dos índices de satisfação dos clientes: análise de informações, criação de planos, monitoramento. Planejamento de atividades para a comunidade. Gestão holística da manutenção predial. Revisa, analisa e interpreta dados de mercado para identificar tendências emergentes que podem impactar o desempenho da propriedade.  Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. Na verdade, procuramos complementar-nos com experiências de outras áreas e organizações, onde o "know-how" pode ser transferível e a multitarefa e a priorização de atividades estão presentes. Pré-requisitos: Carreiras com foco em Hospitality. Experiência liderando equipes de trabalho (operações, serviços, etc...) Experiência desejável nas áreas: Imobiliário, Multifamily, Hotelaria, Administração, Gestão de Projetos, Empreendedorismo, etc... Inglês avançado. Utilização de ferramentas Office 365.  Se você está interessado, então o que está esperando?

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Platform engineer / devops engineer em santo andré. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Senior demand planner – fmcg (position is based in angola!)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior demand planner – fmcg (position is based in angola!) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

International Opportunity! Position is based in Angola! You will be joining a well-established market leader, large group with diversified businesses portfolio, reporting to the Demand Planning Manager and responsible for the following: Key Accountabilities: Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts for decision-making Analyze sales data and market trends to improve forecasting Collaborate with cross-functional teams on factors that impact demand Monitor sales and refine forecasts based on changing conditions Communicate forecast updates to supply planning teams Take ownership and proactively address data quality issues Create, maintain, and manage visual data tools for leadership  Key Responsibilities: Review and analyze historical sales data to identify trends and patterns that can be used to improve accuracy of future forecasts Collaborate with sales, marketing, and other stakeholders to gather information on upcoming promotions, product launches, and other factors that may impact demand Develop statistical models and algorithms to create accurate demand forecasts for different product types Continuously monitor and track actual sales performance against forecast and make necessary adjustments to the forecast as needed Communicate forecast recommendations and updates to stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership Ensure that any add/delete items are promptly updated in the system to avoid impacting forecast accuracy Work with IT and Analytics Data teams to ensure that demand data is available on time for extract and analysis Validate that sales forecast is pulled into the correct line Notify the BI team to push data on time to ensure that reporting and analysis can be done in a timely manner Publish LE (latest estimate) forecasts and other relevant reports to keep stakeholders informed of demand trends and performance Develop and maintain demand planning dashboard to provide real-time visibility into forecasting and demand planning metrics. As well as be able to generate reports and visualizations to communicate forecast accuracy, demand trends, and potential risks to stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making Monitor forecast accuracy and identify areas of improvement to enhance the reliability and precision of demand planning Provide training and support to end-users on utilizing the demand planning dashboard, ensuring widespread adoption and utilization across the organization  Key Requirements: Willing and able to work in Angola Bachelor's Degree as a minimum in relevant field including Finance, Math or Engineering; MBA and/or other professional qualifications are highly preferred 4+ years of Demand Planning experience in a large organization Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and inventory / production planning Proficiency in using demand planning and forecasting tools is necessary Proficiency in using forecast accuracy KPIs Strong experience with ERP and demand planning systems (e.g., SAP APO, Oracle Demantra, Kinaxis, Anaplan) Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)Knowledge of statistical forecasting methods and demand modeling Solid understanding of distribution networks, inventory management, and supply chain dynamics Familiarity with S& OP processes and cross-functional planning Proficiency in analyzing large sets of data and using data visualization tools to identify trends, patterns, and insight Prior FMCG experience will be a plus Ability to influence the decision makers Highest standards of accuracy and precision Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills Highly-driven and self-motivated Proven ability to work with ambiguity

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Analista de compliance regulatório sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de compliance regulatório sênior em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre nós Fundada em 1997 na Coreia do Sul e presente em 19 países, a Mirae Asset é um conglomerado financeiro global que oferece soluções de investimento inovadoras para clientes ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, atuamos como corretora de valores, conectando o mercado local a nossa presença internacional e colocando à disposição de investidores pessoas físicas e institucionais produtos e serviços de primeira linha. Nosso compromisso é unir solidez global, inovação e proximidade no atendimento para apoiar nossos clientes em seus objetivos de investimento. #Vem Ser Mirae Asset Analista de Compliance Regulatório (SR) Sobre a posição O Analista de Compliance Regulatório será responsável por apoiar a estrutura de conformidade regulatória de uma VASP (Virtual Asset Service Provider), garantindo aderência às legislações aplicáveis, normas de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro e financiamento ao terrorismo (PLD/FT), bem como às diretrizes de órgãos reguladores nacionais e internacionais relacionados ao mercado de criptoativos. A posição exige acompanhamento contínuo de mudanças regulatórias, suporte na implementação de controles internos e interação com áreas como jurídico, riscos, produtos e tecnologia. Responsabilidades Monitorar e interpretar regulamentações aplicáveis ao mercado de criptoativos e serviços de ativos virtuais. Apoiar na implementação e manutenção do programa de compliance regulatório da VASP. Contribuir para a adequação às normas de PLD/FT, KYC, KYT e Travel Rule. Elaborar e revisar políticas, procedimentos e controles internos relacionados à conformidade regulatória. Conduzir análises regulatórias para novos produtos, serviços ou funcionalidades envolvendo criptoativos. Apoiar em processos de auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a compliance e requisitos regulatórios. Preparar relatórios e materiais para reguladores, auditorias e comitês internos. Realizar monitoramento de transações e apoiar investigações relacionadas a atividades suspeitas quando necessário. Atuar junto às áreas internas para garantir a implementação adequada de requisitos regulatórios. Acompanhar tendências regulatórias globais no setor de ativos virtuais. Apoiar treinamentos internos sobre compliance, AML e regulamentação de criptoativos.  Requisitos Obrigatórios Graduação em Direito, Economia, Administração, Relações Internacionais, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia em Compliance, AML, PLD/FT ou Risco Regulatório. Conhecimento do mercado de criptoativos e blockchain. Experiência ou familiaridade com regulamentação financeira ou fintech. Conhecimento de processos de KYC, KYT e monitoramento de transações. Capacidade de análise regulatória e elaboração de políticas e relatórios. Inglês intermediário ou avançado.  Desejáveis Experiência prévia em exchange, fintech, banco digital ou VASP. Conhecimento de regulamentações internacionais aplicáveis a criptoativos (ex.: FATF, Mi CA etc.). Experiência com ferramentas de blockchain analytics. Certificações em compliance ou AML. Experiência com auditorias regulatórias ou interação com reguladores.  Diferenciais Experiência em estruturação de programas de compliance para criptoativos. Participação em projetos de adequação regulatória em fintechs. Conhecimento de De Fi, stablecoins, custody, tokens e infraestrutura de ativos digitais.  Local: Avenida Brigadeiro Faria Lima – Itaim Bibi – SP

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em porto alegre. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Trainee comercial — seguros | programa de formação caburé
description:
Nova oportunidade para Trainee comercial — seguros | programa de formação caburé em rio grande do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Você, jovem que está iniciando no mercado de trabalho: Já pensou em construir uma carreira dentro de um dos setores que mais cresce no Brasil? Somos o Grupo Caburé, unimos a tradição dos seguros com a inovação da tecnologia. Nascemos com um propósito simples, porém poderoso: proteger pessoas. Com mais de 62 anos de história, nossa essência está enraizada na confiança, na excelência e na capacidade de transformar vidas por meio de soluções acessíveis, inteligentes e humanas. Atualmente, protegemos mais de 2 milhões de brasileiros, atingindo a marca de 28 bilhões de capitais segurados, e a confiança deles segue sendo nosso maior patrimônio. O Programa de Formação de Especialistas em Seguro de Vida da Caburé foi criado para dar oportunidade de formação a novos entrantes no mercado de seguros, para quem tem ambição de crescer financeira e profissionalmente, ingressando em um dos setores de maior remuneração do mercado financeiro. SOBRE A VAGA: A função é voltada para vendas consultivas, entendendo as necessidades dos clientes e oferecendo soluções personalizadas de proteção financeira. O profissional atuará com prospecção ativa, reuniões com clientes, planejamento financeiro e gestão da própria carteira. Aqui você vai aprender a fazer vendas de forma consultiva na linha de frente do mercado financeiro, onde um talento comercial tem o ambiente ideal para crescer de forma meritocrática. O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ: • Sonho grande • Perfil comercial • Constante busca por evolução e aprendizado • Não precisa ter experiência no setor. Precisa ter vontade de aprender e determinação para vender. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: • Prospecção ativa • Reuniões online e presencial com clientes • Planejamento financeiro personalizado para seus clientes, com foco em seguro de vida • Gestão de CRM com foco em resultado • Construção e manutenção da sua carteira de clientes BENEFÍCIOS: Para você chegar nos seus objetivos, pode esperar da gente: • Comissionamento de até 300% por venda. • Comissão recorrente, enquanto seu cliente estiver pagando. • Garantia de R$ 3.000 mensais, no formato de linha d'água • Ambiente e nicho de vendas de alta conversão; • Plano de carreira definido: você começa como júnior e pode se tornar líder da própria equipe. • Formação completa em vendas consultivas e mercado de seguros com base na nossa expertise de mercado de mais de 62 anos. SAIBA MAIS DA NOSSA HISTÓRIA: Site:  Instagram:@grupocabure Youtube: Grupo Caburé

Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em mogi das cruzes. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

description:

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em palhoça. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Empresa está contratando Artificial intelligence engineer em gaspar. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.  Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)  Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)  Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations  What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles  Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

description:

International Opportunity! Position is based in Angola! You will be joining a well-established market leader, large group with diversified businesses portfolio, reporting to the Demand Planning Manager and responsible for the following: Key Accountabilities: Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts for decision-making Analyze sales data and market trends to improve forecasting Collaborate with cross-functional teams on factors that impact demand Monitor sales and refine forecasts based on changing conditions Communicate forecast updates to supply planning teams Take ownership and proactively address data quality issues Create, maintain, and manage visual data tools for leadership  Key Responsibilities: Review and analyze historical sales data to identify trends and patterns that can be used to improve accuracy of future forecasts Collaborate with sales, marketing, and other stakeholders to gather information on upcoming promotions, product launches, and other factors that may impact demand Develop statistical models and algorithms to create accurate demand forecasts for different product types Continuously monitor and track actual sales performance against forecast and make necessary adjustments to the forecast as needed Communicate forecast recommendations and updates to stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership Ensure that any add/delete items are promptly updated in the system to avoid impacting forecast accuracy Work with IT and Analytics Data teams to ensure that demand data is available on time for extract and analysis Validate that sales forecast is pulled into the correct line Notify the BI team to push data on time to ensure that reporting and analysis can be done in a timely manner Publish LE (latest estimate) forecasts and other relevant reports to keep stakeholders informed of demand trends and performance Develop and maintain demand planning dashboard to provide real-time visibility into forecasting and demand planning metrics. As well as be able to generate reports and visualizations to communicate forecast accuracy, demand trends, and potential risks to stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making Monitor forecast accuracy and identify areas of improvement to enhance the reliability and precision of demand planning Provide training and support to end-users on utilizing the demand planning dashboard, ensuring widespread adoption and utilization across the organization  Key Requirements: Willing and able to work in Angola Bachelor's Degree as a minimum in relevant field including Finance, Math or Engineering; MBA and/or other professional qualifications are highly preferred 4+ years of Demand Planning experience in a large organization Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and inventory / production planning Proficiency in using demand planning and forecasting tools is necessary Proficiency in using forecast accuracy KPIs Strong experience with ERP and demand planning systems (e. G., Power BI, Tableau)Knowledge of statistical forecasting methods and demand modeling Solid understanding of distribution networks, inventory management, and supply chain dynamics Familiarity with S& OP processes and cross-functional planning Proficiency in analyzing large sets of data and using data visualization tools to identify trends, patterns, and insight Prior FMCG experience will be a plus Ability to influence the decision makers Highest standards of accuracy and precision Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills Highly-driven and self-motivated Proven ability to work with ambiguity

description:

GTM builder   You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. title: Graphic designer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Graphic designer em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Graphic Designer  Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.  You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.  What you’ll do   You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns  Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web  Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow  Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns  Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG) Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations  Edit video for social distribution and website use  Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative  This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.    What matters in this role   You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction  You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio  You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time  You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement  You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks    Requirements   4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams  Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals  Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts) Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video) Video editing experience for social and web content  Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite    Context for the work   Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:  Driving registrations and product demos  Increasing engagement  Supporting sales follow-up  Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders    The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.  What this is not   Not a pure brand exploration role  Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment  Not isolated design work handed over a wall    You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.  If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em itaquaquecetuba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title:  AI Engineer  Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.” Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. A eliminação dos dados em nossos sistemas ocorrerá de forma automática no prazo de 6 (seis) meses contados da data de sua candidatura ou mediante sua solicitação através do e-mail:   Tal consentimento é exclusivo para fins de candidaturas, limitando a responsabilidade das empresas do Grupo Britânia a este fim, não sendo responsáveis pelo cadastro, registro e tratamento de seus dados em redes sociais, nos sites e plataformas de oferta de vagas.
